title: 003 月姬笑送帖，冥侯怒杀人
content_zh:
“绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉。晚来天欲雪，能饮一杯无？”一位身穿黑衣，面目冷峻的男子坐在马车之上，手举一个酒杯，笑着望向面前的人。
一共十六个人，每个人都握着一把刀，如雪一般亮的刀。
“兄台好雅兴。”为首的刀客笑了笑，“可是酒我们可以喝，但马车上的东西，你得留下了。”
“哦？”黑衣男子嘴角微扬，“这大雪天你们跟了我一路实在过于辛苦，但你们要的东西注定拿不到，便想请你们喝了这杯酒，然后……”
“然后？”刀客眉毛一挑，握刀的力度大了几分。
“然后去死！”黑衣男子一跃而起，手中银光乍现。
刀客提刀而上，怒喝一声：“上！”
只听清脆的一声撞击，黑衣男子右手的银光直接撞上了刀客的刀刃。
“指尖刃。”刀客倒吸一口冷气，他似乎听到了有东西一点点破裂的声音，他急忙后撤，但是已经来不及了，他手中那把亮得如雪一样的刀，竟在瞬间就折断了。
黑衣男子笑着将手抬起，刀客看着那柄薄如蝉翼的指尖刃在男子的手中舞出了无比美妙的刀花，一朵两朵，随即化成了千朵万朵，像是瞬间盛开的佛莲般美丽。但刀客已经看不到了，那柄指尖刃在他脖子上轻轻划出了一道血痕。黑衣男子足尖一点，掠出了三步之远，刀客的整个头颅滑了下来，鲜血直涌。
“派你们来的人或许没有告诉你们我究竟是谁。”黑衣男子回到了马车之上，重新拿起了刚刚放下的酒杯，“或许你们现在愿意喝上这最后一杯酒了？”
“指尖刃，你是蜀中唐门的人？”刀客们纷纷后撤。
“或许吧。”黑衣男子衣袖一挥，一柄红尾小箭瞬间钉在了一名刀客的额头上，“你说我是唐门的人，那这一支朱颜小箭便送给你吧。”
世界安静到仿佛又只有雪轻轻落下的声音了。还有一十三名刀客站着，但是谁也没有再敢说话，谁也不知道下一把暗器会不会冲自己飞来，他们每个人都摒住了呼吸，在唐门的暗器下，活下去的机会只有一次。
黑衣男子笑了笑，轻轻拉了拉缰绳：“驾！”
那架马车就带着他怡怡然地从那十三名刀客之中踏雪而去，没有任何一个人敢去试图阻拦。
直到马车驶出了三里之外，一直浅笑着喝酒的黑衣男子终于放下了酒杯，重重地开始咳嗽起来，他擦了擦嘴角咳出的血迹，苦笑了一下：“师尊这次托我运送的到底是什么货物，一路上引来这么多的高手。”
男子说完用力一甩缰绳，整个人一翻身，跃到了车篷之上。而车篷上竟不知何时已站着一个人，那人约莫三十多的年纪，一头白发在风中飘摇，手中提着一把玉剑，颇有几分仙气。
“唐莲？”那人转头冲着男子一笑，脚尖轻轻一点，从车篷上跃了出去，悠悠然地落在了旁边的一棵枯树上。
而男子手中指尖刃光芒闪动，已然刺出，却只扑了个空。

“你知道我的名字？”男子瞳孔蓦然缩紧。
“我们还会再见的。”白发男子却并不回答，束剑微笑。
马车此时踏着一路飞雪绝尘而去。
“白发玉剑，轻功卓越。怎么从未听师尊说过江湖上有这样的高手？”
此时已是深夜，外面的雪越下越大，唐莲将马车赶进了一家破旧的寺庙之中，生了一堆火准备稍做休息。可他却始终想着白天见到的那个人，那男子落在车篷之上时，杀气之盛让那一片风雪几乎逆流，可等唐莲与他正面对决时，他却似乎并没有一战的意思，以他的轻功身法和杀气之盛，唐莲并没有必胜的把握。
“真是个奇怪的人。”唐莲将手中的稻草扔进了火中，而就在这时，门口却突然传来了一声马嘶。唐莲立刻双手一挥，将火堆扑灭，整个人向上一跃，坐在了横梁之上。
“这雪也太大了，到底还要下多久才能消停。”一个人大声抱怨着冲进了庙中，一屁股坐了下来，听声音似乎是个有些稚嫩的少年。
“哼，要不是我的马是千里挑一的神骏，我们早就被雪给埋了。”另一人慢悠悠地也跟着走了进来，声音也是懒洋洋的，声音却似乎听着要稍长几岁。
“喂喂喂，你这一路说了多久，你是个卖马的么？”少年有些不耐烦。
“先来生个火吧。”另一人也不理他。
“庙里似乎却也不冷。”少年声音里带着些困惑，“似乎……”
“刚有人生过火？”另一人俯下身，手轻轻地碰了一下地上的草灰，转头看了一眼少年，“是热的。”
一直躺在横梁上闭目的唐莲瞬间睁开了眼睛，他轻轻一个翻身，整个人悄无声息地垂直落下，指尖刃夹在手中，笔直地冲着那人而去。
“太好了。这样就方便了！”少年喜形于色，“我还怕草是湿的，怎么都点不着呢。”
唐莲一愣，心道：莫非只是两个寻常的赶路人？他急忙从袖中扔出一条细线，缠在了横梁之上，又将自己拉了回去。
下面二人此时已经将火生了起来，坐在边上烤起了手。唐莲就着火光望去，只见其中一人只穿着单薄的红衣，面目俊秀，而另一人却是穿着厚厚的狐裘大衣，整个人缩在其中，懒洋洋地靠在柱子上。
“雷无桀，你说要带我去雪月城，却是已经走错了两次方向，这一次你确定路是对的？”这二人自然便是从雪落山庄出发的萧瑟和雷无桀，可出发了有十天有余了，因为风雪实在太大，二人却是在原地徘徊了很久。
雷无桀无奈地笑笑：“其实我也是第一次去雪月城，不过我发誓，这一次一定是对的。”
听到雪月城三字，唐莲心中一动，望向雷无桀。
他姓雷？莫非来自江南霹雳堂雷家？可是雷无桀这个名字，却从未听人说过。

萧瑟看着雷无桀冷笑了一下，也不理他，闭上了眼睛。
“萧瑟……”雷无桀忽然皱了皱眉头，使劲在空气中嗅了嗅，“你有没有闻到一股味道。”
“味道？”萧瑟睁开了眼睛，吸了吸鼻子，“是花香，蔷薇之香。”
雷无桀站了起来，望向门外：“蔷薇会在下雪天开么？”
“不会。是蔷薇露的香味。蔷薇露，出大食、占城、爪哇、回回国，只有帝都的百花阁才能买到……”萧瑟没有站起身，只是扭头看向门外，那里不知何时却已站着一个女人。
一个很美很美的女人。她穿着一身紫色的薄衫，风轻轻吹气她的长衫，银色的月光照在她的身上，显得她整个人莹白如玉，她冲着门内的人微微一笑，蔷薇的淡淡清香随着她一笑，似乎变得更加温柔起来。
她的声音却也是温柔无比：“想不到在此荒郊之地，还能遇到能识辨风雅之人。我苦求百花阁主多日，她才卖给了我这一瓶，你却一下就闻了出来。”
萧瑟笑笑，回她：“风高月冷，我们在里面生了火，很暖和，姑娘要进来坐坐吗？”
“不必了。”女人依旧温柔地笑着，伸手捋了捋鬓发。
“你很美，当风吹起你的鬓发上，那种风情就更美了。”萧瑟转头看向雷无桀，“可是我的这位小兄弟，一心只有一颗英雄梦，美人心，他怕是还不懂的。”
雷无桀此时手中已经夹着一张金贴，那是女人伸手捋头发之时从她手中飞出来的，速度极快，连雷无桀都吃了一惊。雷无桀拿起金帖一看，上面四四方方，只写着一个字。
雷无桀想起了一个传说，他虽是第一次涉猎江湖，但是从小他就喜欢听江湖上的各种传说。比如，江湖上就流传着这样一句话。
“月姬笑送帖，冥侯怒杀人。”
content_en:
"New fermented wine from green ants, small red clay stove. It's getting snowy this evening, can you have a drink?" A man in black with a stern face sat on the carriage, holding a wine glass in his hand and looking at the person in front of him with a smile.
There were sixteen people in total, each holding a knife, as bright as snow.
"Brother, you are so cheerful." The leading swordsman smiled, "But we can drink the wine, but you have to keep the things on the carriage."
"Oh?" The man in black raised his lips slightly, "It's too hard for you to follow me all the way on this snowy day, but you are bound to not get what you want, so I want to treat you to a glass of wine, and then..."
"Then?" The swordsman raised his eyebrows and held the knife a little harder.
"Then die!" The man in black jumped up, silver light suddenly appearing in his hand.
The swordsman came up with the sword and shouted angrily: "Go!"
There was only a crisp impact, and the silver light from the man in black's right hand directly hit the swordsman's blade.
"Fingertip blade." The swordsman gasped. He seemed to hear the sound of something breaking. He hurriedly retreated, but it was too late. The knife in his hand, as bright as snow, broke in an instant.
The man in black smiled and raised his hand. The swordsman watched as the fingertip blade, as thin as a cicada's wings, danced into extremely beautiful sword flowers in the man's hand. One or two flowers, and then turned into thousands of flowers, as beautiful as a Buddha lotus blooming in an instant. But the swordsman could no longer see it, and the fingertip blade lightly drew a bloody mark on his neck. The man in black pointed his toes and took three steps away. The swordsman's entire head slipped off, and blood poured out.
"The person who sent you may not have told you who I am." The man in black returned to the carriage and picked up the wine glass he had just put down. "Perhaps you are willing to drink this last glass of wine now?"
"Fingertip Blade, are you from the Tang Clan in Sichuan?" The swordsmen retreated one after another.
"Maybe." The man in black waved his sleeve, and a small red-tailed arrow was instantly nailed to the forehead of a swordsman. "You said that I am from the Tang Sect, so I will give you this little red-tailed arrow."
The world was so quiet that there was only the sound of snow falling gently. There were still thirteen swordsmen standing, but no one dared to speak anymore. No one knew whether the next hidden weapon would fly towards them. Each of them held their breath. Under the Tang Sect's hidden weapons, they only had one chance to survive.
The man in black smiled and gently pulled the reins: "Drive!"
The carriage took him happily walking through the snow among the thirteen swordsmen, and no one dared to try to stop him.
Until the carriage drove three miles away, the man in black, who had been drinking with a smile, finally put down his glass and began to cough heavily. He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and smiled bitterly: "What kind of cargo did Master ask me to transport this time? It attracted so many experts along the way."
After the man finished speaking, he shook the reins vigorously, turned over, and jumped onto the hood of the car. Unexpectedly, there was a person standing on the hood of the car. The man was about thirty years old. His white hair was swaying in the wind. He was holding a jade sword in his hand, and he had a somewhat fairy air.
"Tang Lian?" The man turned around and smiled at the man. With a tap of his toes, he jumped out from the hood of the car and landed leisurely on a dead tree next to him.
The blade on the fingertips of the man's hand flashed with light, and he thrust out, but it only missed.
"Do you know my name?" The man's pupils suddenly narrowed.
"We will meet again." The white-haired man did not answer, but smiled with his sword tied.
The carriage drove away in the snow and dust.
"White-haired jade sword, excellent light skill. Why have I never heard from Master that there is such a master in the world?"
It was already late at night, and the snow outside was getting heavier and heavier. Tang Lian drove the carriage into a dilapidated temple, lit a fire and prepared to take a rest. But he always thought about BaiThe man Tian saw, when the man landed on the hood of the car, his murderous aura made the wind and snow almost flow against the current. But when Tang Lian faced him head-on, he seemed to have no intention of fighting. With his light kung fu and strong murderous aura, Tang Lian was not sure of victory.
"What a strange person." Tang Lian threw the straw in her hand into the fire, and at this moment, a horse neighed suddenly from the door. Tang Lian immediately put out the fire with a wave of her hands, jumped up, and sat on the beam.
"This snow is too heavy. How long will it continue to fall before it stops?" A man complained loudly and rushed into the temple and sat down. From the sound of his voice, he seemed to be a somewhat immature boy.
"Hmph, if my horse hadn't been the best horse in a thousand, we would have been buried in the snow." Another man followed slowly and walked in. His voice was also lazy, but his voice seemed to be a few years older.
"Hey, hey, hey, how long have you been talking about here? Are you a horse seller?" The young man was a little impatient.
"Let's light a fire first." The other person ignored him.
"It doesn't seem to be cold in the temple." There was confusion in the young man's voice, "It seems..."
"Did someone just have a fire?" Another person leaned down and gently touched the grass ashes on the ground. He turned to look at the young man and said, "It's hot."
Tang Lian, who had been lying on the beam with her eyes closed, opened her eyes in an instant. He turned over gently and fell vertically silently. With the fingertip blade in his hand, he went straight towards the man.
"Great. This is so convenient!" The young man beamed, "I was afraid that the grass would be wet and it wouldn't light up."
Tang Lian was stunned and thought to herself: Could it be that they are just two ordinary passers-by? He hurriedly threw a thin line from his sleeve, wrapped it around the beam, and pulled himself back.
The two people below had already lit the fire and sat on the edge to warm their hands. Tang Lian looked at the firelight and saw that one of them was only wearing a thin red coat and had a handsome face, while the other was wearing a thick fox fur coat and was huddled in it, leaning lazily against the pillar.
"Lei Wujie, you said you wanted to take me to Xueyue City, but you have already gone in the wrong direction twice. Are you sure you are going the right way this time?" These two people were naturally Xiao Se and Lei Wujie who set out from Xueluo Villa, but it had been more than ten days since they set out. Because the wind and snow were so heavy, they lingered in place for a long time.
Lei Wujie smiled helplessly: "Actually, this is also my first time to go to Xueyue City, but I swear, I will do it right this time."
Hearing the words Xueyue City, Tang Lian's heart moved and she looked at Lei Wujie.
His last name is Lei? Could it be that he is from the Lei family of Jiangnan Perak Hall? But the name Lei Wujie has never been heard by anyone.
Xiao Se looked at Lei Wujie and sneered, ignoring him and closing his eyes.
"Xiao Se..." Lei Wujie suddenly frowned and sniffed the air vigorously, "Did you smell something?"
"Smell?" Xiao Se opened his eyes and sniffed, "It's the scent of flowers, the scent of roses."
Lei Wujie stood up and looked out the door: "Will roses bloom in the snow?"
"No. It's the scent of rose dew. Rose dew can only be purchased at Baihua Pavilion in the imperial capital when you go to Dashi, Champa, Java, or Huihui..." Xiao Se didn't stand up, but just turned to look outside the door. I don't know when a woman was already standing there.
A very beautiful woman. She was wearing a purple thin gown, the wind blew her gown gently, and the silver moonlight shone on her body, making her whole body as white as jade. She smiled at the person inside the door, and the faint fragrance of roses seemed to become more gentle as she smiled.
But her voice was also extremely gentle: "I never thought that in this deserted place, I could meet someone who can recognize elegance. I begged the Master of Baihua Pavilion for many days before she sold me this bottle, but you smelled it right away."Xiao Se smiled and replied to her: "The wind is high and the moon is cold. We lit a fire inside. It's very warm. Girl, do you want to come in and sit down?"
"No need." The woman still smiled softly and reached out to smooth her hair.
"You are beautiful. When the wind blows on your temples, your style becomes even more beautiful." Xiao Se turned to look at Lei Wujie, "But this little brother of mine only has a heroic dream and a beautiful heart. I'm afraid he still doesn't understand."
Lei Wujie already had a gold sticker in his hand. It flew out of the woman's hand when she was combing her hair. It was so fast that even Lei Wujie was surprised. Lei Wujie picked up the gold post and looked at it. There was only one word written on it in a square shape.
Lei Wujie remembered a legend. Although it was his first time to dabble in the world, he had liked listening to various legends in the world since he was a child. For example, there is such a saying circulating in the world.
"Yue Ji smiled and sent the message, while Ming Hou killed people in anger."
